title: Scrub dead search tool references from README and wiki guides
description:
P0: `README.md` line 158 contains a copy-pasteable JSON example calling `memorysmith_unified_search` — a tool removed in TSK-0271. Two wiki guide pages (`Data/Pages/guides/search-and-chat.md`, `Data/Pages/features/api-and-mcp.md`) also document `memorysmith_semantic_search`/`memorysmith_unified_search` as live tools with full format tables and "when to use" guidance. These pages are themselves retrievable by `memorysmith_page_search`, so agents asking "what search tools are available" through the system's own search can be told to call nonexistent tools.

Scope:
- Update `README.md` worked example + tool table: replace with `memorysmith_hybrid_search`
- Update `search-and-chat.md` — remove deprecated rows or add explicit "removed in TSK-0271" callout
- Update `api-and-mcp.md` — same treatment
- Verify: grep for `unified_search` in docs returns zero results outside changelog/removal-notes

Evidence: MemorySmith-Audit-20260702.md §2.1, memorysmith-deep-audit-20260703.md §6/§10, council/audit-synthesis-council-20260705.md

comments.author: AgentSmith
comments.body: Created from 6-seat council audit synthesis. Retrieval Specialist rated as P0 — every new integrator reads a broken example. Human Learning Advocate rated as 10-minute fix that prevents immediate onboarding trap.
